freshScientificGrounds.conceptContract: The goal asks for one transferable explanatory approach: accurately describe biological mechanisms, structure them with suitable basic concepts and connect interdisciplinary conditions. The profile requires mechanistic relationships, bounded applications and a relevant physical/chemical quantity rather than merely naming concepts.
freshScientificGrounds.concept-leaf: Stomatal closure can reduce water-vapor loss and CO2 entry. The 8-to-3 and 6-to-2 relative model changes yield differences of 5 and 4 without proving proportional photosynthesis. Matter and energy are distinguished. The fresh temperature-versus-humidity condition requires analyzing vapor-pressure gradient, evaporation and regulation, not substituting one variable mechanically. The new image is a correct illustrative typical underside example and adds no universal anatomical rule.
freshScientificGrounds.concept-enzyme: Lactase hydrolyzes lactose into glucose and galactose. The active-site and pH account is correct; substrate transport may limit the support application. An impermeable support in the constructed model can prevent the substrate from reaching the enclosed enzyme, so constant enzyme amount alone does not guarantee equal turnover. Equal short-term conversion does not establish unlimited lifetime or long-term performance. No actual experimental run or clinical recommendation is claimed.
freshScientificGrounds.coverageAndTransfer: Both distinct applications exercise essential-1, essential-2 and essential-3 with worked changed-condition responses. The required expectation IDs and two planned independent demonstrations are coverage requirements, not evidence that anyone already performed them.
freshScientificGrounds.language: The expectations and complete case demands, performances and rubrics preserve equivalent German and English scientific meaning. The retained English variation-axis label contains some German context nouns; it does not change the scientific content and is not a new image-induced fault. No unrelated wording change is proposed.
freshScientificGrounds.newAltText: The new alt text correctly describes the curled underside, the magnified guard-cell pair and pore, upper-surface light entry, underside CO2 entry and root water uptake. It remains tied to this illustrated plant, not an all-species anatomical assertion.
